set.body:
Goal: introduce the single operator type and the two composition primitives, plus the unified latent parameter. Design: docs/plans/multivar-operator-core.md §3–§5.

`Op[From <: Coordinate, To <: Coordinate, R <: Role]` — one directed operator carrying the numeric OperatorKernel (tagged with OperatorRepresentation: Dense/Sparse/Diagonal/Block/LowRank/Kronecker/LazyAffine/MatrixFree) INSIDE it. Role is a phantom tag + runtime value. Evidence stays runtime-authoritative (a Certificate bound to valueIdentity) with a type-level evidence-lattice tag (CertifiedSpd <: CertifiedPsd <: CertifiedSymmetric, plus Assumed*); Unsafe.* with a mandatory reason remains the only assertion escape. Role aliases per §3: Table, Metric, Cometric, Covariance, Scatter, RowLink, Frame.

Both primitives are named, role-stamping compositions over the existing `Lin.andThen`/`.star` — not new machinery:
- secondOrder(xs, l, xt) = xt.andThen(l).andThen(xs.star) : C_t* → C_s. Verified orientation. One op generates covariance/scatter/cross-cov/between-within/co-inertia/multiset blocks — they differ only in L, supplied by the existing RowRelationships ADT (TypedRowLink/Coupling/IncidenceMap/PartialInjection/HubAlignment).
- compress(ws, s, wt) = wt.andThen(s).andThen(ws.star) : K_t → K_s*.

FunctionalFrame(w, cometric): w is the primary parameter (W : K → C*); scores = w.andThen(x) (= XW : K → O), axes = w.andThen(q) (= QW : K → C) are derived accessors. This replaces the six-record GenPCA result zoo (StandardRowScores/PrincipalRowScores/ColumnAxes/ColumnMetricLoadings/RowMetricLoadings/RowDualPrincipalScores in GenPcaSemantics.scala). Build against the parameterization seam (§6.2): FunctionalFrame IS the semantic θ, so a Parameterization (identity for now) can sit above it later without rework.

Acceptance: types compile on JVM+JS; secondOrder/compress orientation + composition laws unit-tested against a direct dense reference; role aliases defined; computes only on Op.kernel (no second engine introduced). `sbt multivarJVM/test multivarJS/test` green.
set.title: Multivar: unified Op type + secondOrder/compress primitives + FunctionalFrame
